issues.source_quote: Фрис-стрит, рыбна улица, - Аптека «Чиканук»...
issues.translation_quote: Frith Street, Fish Street, - The "Chikanuk" pharmacy...
issues.justification: The mock-foreign gibberish ("рыбна улица" in broken Russian) is rendered as plain English; the pseudo-foreign flavor of the rehearsed spy phrase is lost, and 'Frith' is an unmotivated change of 'Фрис'.

issues.source_quote: Мы вообще дальше Дубровки никуда не ездили.
issues.translation_quote: We've never been further than Dubrovka.
issues.justification: Acceptable literally, but combined with 'Daddy' etc. it is fine; however the joke of the provincial family is kept. (Minor concern only.)

issues.source_quote: Нет, шуба подождёт. Я считаю, главное - это поглядеть мир!
issues.translation_quote: No, the fur coat can wait.
issues.justification: Fine, but the following 'Нет, я никуда не еду. Мы провожаем папу' joke is intact; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Упал, выругался... Чёрт возьми! Ух, прости, "Чёрт побери!"
issues.translation_quote: fell, cursed... Dammit! Oops, sorry, "Devil take it!"
issues.justification: The point is that the password phrase is 'Чёрт побери' and he slips into a variant; 'Dammit' vs 'Devil take it' conveys it, but 'Dammit' is a different register from the polite Soviet curse, weakening the gag.

issues.source_quote: Щёрт побери, щёрт побери!
issues.translation_quote: Dyevil take eet, dyevil take eet!
issues.justification: Phonetic rendering is a creative solution, but it is applied inconsistently ('Devil take it' elsewhere in the same scene), weakening the running gag of foreign accents.

issues.source_quote: Вы в самодеятельности участвуете?
issues.translation_quote: Do you do amateur theatricals?
issues.justification: Reasonable, but later 'Семён Семёнович, ну давайте без самодеятельности!' is rendered 'no amateur theatricals', which loses the sense of 'no improvising/freelancing'.

issues.source_quote: Мы вообще дальше Дубровки никуда не ездили.
issues.translation_quote: We've never been further than Dubrovka.
issues.justification: Dubrovka is not explained; minor loss of local color.

issues.source_quote: Пейте, пейте... - Товарищ капитан, - Да. но что ж мне теперь делать?
issues.translation_quote: Doctors recommend it: calms the nervous system, dilates the blood vessels...
issues.justification: The 'Неделя' section refers to a weekly newspaper supplement; the translation retains 'Nedelya' without explanation, and the humor of the captain quoting household tips is dulled.

issues.source_quote: Что у Вас с головой? Деньги!
issues.translation_quote: What's wrong with your head? The money!
issues.justification: Hardly an error, but 'Новыми?' joke (new rubles after 1961 reform) is rendered 'New rubles?' without effect for an English audience.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy your tickets by the stack, and you'll win... A water-pumping shack!
issues.justification: The rhyme is attempted but 'water-pumping shack' is unnatural; the absurd lottery-prize joke is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Клёв!... Клёв будет, это я беру на себя! Клевать будет так, что клиент позабудет обо всём на свете!
issues.translation_quote: They'll bite so hard the client'll forget everything in the world!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike the iron without leaving the till!
issues.justification: The mangled proverb is rendered as a calque; 'strike while the iron is hot' hybrid with 'without leaving the cash register' would be the recognizable English blend. As is, the humor of the mixed idiom is partly lost.

issues.source_quote: в нашем деле гланое - этот самый реализм
issues.translation_quote: the main thing is that there realism
issues.justification: Awkward; the boss's slangy mispronunciation isn't convincingly conveyed.

issues.source_quote: Ну что Вы, время! Время - деньги!
issues.translation_quote: Come on, time! Time is money!
issues.justification: Stiff and abrupt in the speaker's mouth.

issues.source_quote: Оружие при Вас? Психическое...
issues.translation_quote: The psychiatric one...
issues.justification: 'Психическое' (psychological, from earlier 'психологическое') is mistranslated as 'psychiatric', changing the meaning and the earlier 'psychological' term.

issues.source_quote: Пятый, пятый, он вошёл, приём! ... Девять ноль-ноль...
issues.translation_quote: Twenty-one hundred...
issues.justification: 'Девять ноль-ноль' is nine o'clock (as arranged), but the translation changes it to 21:00, a different time format that breaks consistency and clarity.

issues.source_quote: Нет, мне надо посоветоваться с шефом! С начальством...
issues.translation_quote: No, I need to consult the boss! My superiors...
issues.justification: Acceptable; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Это Вам! Сувенир... Кнопочку нажмите.
issues.translation_quote: Press the little button.
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Шампанское по утрам пьют или аристократы, или дегенераты!
issues.translation_quote: Champagne in the morning is drunk by either aristocrats or degenerates!
issues.justification: Correct; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Я встретил Вас и всё былое В отжившем сердце ожило
issues.translation_quote: I met you — and all the past Came alive in my outworn heart...
issues.justification: Acceptable; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках!
issues.translation_quote: Drop dead! May I see you in yer coffin, in white slippers!
issues.justification: The neighbor's dialect is partially conveyed; fine.

issues.source_quote: Козлодоев... Козадоев! Казладоев!
issues.translation_quote: Kozlodoyev... Kozadoyev! Kozzlodoyev!
issues.justification: The pun of Kozlodoyev (goat-milker, an insult) vs Kozadoyev is not conveyed; the mocking name-slip loses its sense in English.

issues.source_quote: Собака - друг человека! ... Управдом - друг человека!
issues.translation_quote: The building manager is man's best friend!
issues.justification: Preserved; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Нет, с ночёвкой не поеду, боюсь застудить.
issues.translation_quote: I'm afraid it'll catch a chill.
issues.justification: The object (the arm) is dropped, so 'it' is unclear in English.

issues.source_quote: Ну что Вы так, Семён Семёнович... Спокойно… Выпейте!
issues.translation_quote: Now, now, Semyon Semyonovich... Easy… Drink this!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Такова «сё ля ви», как говорят у них...
issues.translation_quote: Such is "c'est la vie", as they say over there...
issues.justification: The original deliberately mangled spelling of the French phrase; the comic phonetic quality is replaced with correct spelling.

issues.source_quote: [фигня]
issues.translation_quote: [rubbish]
issues.justification: Register slightly off; 'crap'/'meh' fits Senya's colloquial tone better.

issues.source_quote: Строго на север, порядка... 50-ти метров, расположен туалэт, типа сортир, обозначенный на схеме буквами «Мэ» и «Жо».
issues.translation_quote: marked on the diagram with the letters "Em" and "Eff".
issues.justification: The letters М and Ж (men/women) are a joke on Cyrillic labels; transliterating as 'Em' and 'Eff' makes no sense to English readers.

issues.source_quote: пыхты
issues.translation_quote: fur tree / fir tree
issues.justification: Inconsistent rendering of the same word within one passage ('fur tree' then 'fir tree'); 'fur tree' appears a typo.

issues.source_quote: Ага-га-га-га
issues.translation_quote: Ha-ha-ha
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Тогда я тебя укушу! Кусай! А-гры-ы...
issues.translation_quote: Grrr...
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Gesha
issues.translation_quote: Gesha
issues.justification: Fine.
